title: Will It Rain?
setting: A bright living room with a large window, a television and a radio.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Raj
characters.look: Raj, a young boy with glasses and a blue sweater

sentences.en: Zoe and Raj want to go to the beach.
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt and Raj, a young boy with glasses and a blue sweater hold a beach ball and a bucket in the living room, looking excited.

sentences.en: They need information about the weather tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 他们需要明天的天气信息。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt and Raj, a young boy with glasses and a blue sweater look out of the large window at a cloudy sky, thinking.

sentences.en: Raj looks in the newspaper but finds nothing.
sentences.zh: 拉吉翻了翻报纸，但什么也没找到。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young boy with glasses and a blue sweater turns the pages of a big newspaper with a puzzled face.

sentences.en: Zoe's magazine only has pretty pictures of clothes.
sentences.zh: 佐伊的杂志里只有漂亮的衣服图片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt flips through a magazine full of pictures of dresses and shoes.

sentences.en: Then they turn on the radio for the news.
sentences.zh: 然后他们打开收音机听新闻。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young boy with glasses and a blue sweater turns the knob of an old radio while Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt listens closely.

sentences.en: The television says rain is coming, too.
sentences.scene_prompt: A television in the living room shows a map with big rain clouds; Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt and Raj, a young boy with glasses and a blue sweater watch.

sentences.en: "Why does it always rain?" asks Zoe sadly.
sentences.zh: “为什么总是下雨呢？”佐伊难过地问。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt sits sadly on the sofa with her chin in her hands, rain on the window.

sentences.en: They watch a funny video or play games.
sentences.zh: 他们看搞笑视频或者玩游戏。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt and Raj, a young boy with glasses and a blue sweater laugh at a funny video on a tablet, board games on the table beside them.
